metadata.description: Three Claude Code mods that run your workday: a daily command center, a focus lock, and a done chime.

plugins.name: daily-command-center
plugins.description: Every morning Claude asks for the three tasks you need to do today, then pins them in a side pane next to your revenue and key numbers.

plugins.name: focus-lock
plugins.description: Start a timed sprint on one task with /sprint. Prompts about anything else are held until the timer ends.

plugins.name: done-chime
plugins.description: Plays a chime and shows a toast when Claude finishes a long job, so you can walk away from the screen.
